rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent bent-and-cantilevered mass in all views, so it has a readable dominant gesture and acceptable hierarchy. However, the visible mass is predominantly an introverted stepped object sitting within the parcel, with only a weak ground-cut and no strong public void, court, or entry seam on the verified access edge. Because the brief requires a neighborhood-living building with an active street threshold and a clear public void/terrace, the form currently under-supports the semantic contract: it behaves more like an abstract sculpted compact block than a neighborhood street building. The silhouette is not a failure, but the section logic is too generic and does not clearly articulate public ground, terrace, or active frontage. It also only weakly responds to the access edge; the blue frontage is not met with a legible opening or undercut. Overall coherent massing, but program-fit is not hard-pass due to missing public threshold logic.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much taller tower typology than the candidate; transferable only as controlled taper/step logic, not as overall height or skyline object.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact mixed-use prism with a carved/offset profile and legible stepped upper mass can support a neighborhood-living brief when the ground relationship stays active.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office tower precedent; candidate is low and compact, so only the continuity and profile logic transfer.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A single dominant mass with a softened/torqued profile can preserve hierarchy while giving the section a clearer vertical reading.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The reference is materially and typologically more literal storefront/cafe; only the active threshold and compactness transfer.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact street-edge object with an attached vertical marker and clear ground threshold can fit neighborhood commercial living.

warnings: Parcel containment appears satisfied; the failure is semantic/sectional, not boundary overflow.
The verified access edge is not answered with a clear public void or entry seam.
Avoid rewarding the stepped top as a meaningful inhabited terrace; here it reads more as an arbitrary tiered cap than program-justified section.
No geometry edits proposed because the current request is a score-only evaluation and the visible form already compiles as a coherent single mass.
